AC3 — the new statement does not assert that dependent calls may be merged and does not conflate parallel dispatch with writing fewer, larger Edit hunks.
AC4 — nothing in the change widens what a run may execute: the same commands, reads and dispatches remain permitted or denied exactly as today.
AC5 — the wording preserves the commit-before-dispatch obligation for write-capable subagent dispatches (#1254).
